definition: [ עָשַׂק ] verb Hithpa`el contend (perhaps originally cling to (in strife), compare Arabic cling with love ( Lag BN 143 ); Syriac , Ethpa`al be difficult (i.e. indignant, hostile ); Late Hebrew עָסַק , ᵑ7 עֲסַק , busy oneself , Late Hebrew עֵסֶק business, occupation ); — Perfect 3 plural הִתְעַשְּׂקוּ עִמּוֺ Gen 26:20 they contended with him .
